analyst.summary: Mphasis is a well-run, low-debt IT services company with solid returns on capital and revenue growth that is currently outpacing many larger IT peers, at a reasonable valuation. A slower industry-wide period a couple of years ago still weighs on its longer-term growth score, but the recent trend is healthy. We are calling this a Hold, upgrading it from the model's initial Sell signal given the current fundamentals.
